definitions.gloss: home-based care; home nursing care; at-home caregiving
definitions.explanation: Providing nursing or caregiving services to elderly or disabled individuals in their own home, rather than in a hospital or care facility. A major topic in Japan's aging society.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}を{選|えら}ぶ{家族|かぞく}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More families are choosing home-based care.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}は{家族|かぞく}の{負担|ふたん}が{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: Home-based care places a heavy burden on the family.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}サービスを{利用|りよう}して、{母|はは}を{自宅|じたく}で{看|み}ている。
examples.english: I'm looking after my mother at home using home care services.

notes: Composed of {在宅|ざいたく} (at home) + {介護|かいご} (nursing care). A key term in Japan's {高齢化社会|こうれいかしゃかい} (aging society) discussions. Common related terms: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}サービス (home care services), {訪問介護|ほうもんかいご} (visiting care), {介護保険|かいごほけん} (long-term care insurance). Contrasts with {施設介護|しせつかいご} (institutional/facility care). The {介護保険|かいごほけん} system provides support for both types.
